name: edgekits
description: Agent skills and Claude plugins from EdgeKits.

plugins.name: repoaccess
plugins.description: Sell access to a private GitHub repo with Stripe: gets you to the setup wizard of RepoAccess core, a free, self-hosted Cloudflare Worker.

plugins.name: telegram-bot-security-audit
plugins.description: Security audit for Telegram bot code: webhook and Mini App authenticity, admin gates, chat identity in groups and guest mode, Stars payments and refunds, token leaks. The platform-specific holes generic scanners miss.

plugins.name: project-journal
plugins.description: Persistent project memory for Claude Code: a small markdown journal loads at every session start, every session is captured when it ends, and decisions become ADRs.

plugins.name: project-curator
plugins.description: A curator for projects built with a coding agent: verifies the agent's reports against the sources, argues options with you, and writes the relay prompts you hand to the agent.

plugins.name: edgekits-i18n
plugins.description: Edge-native i18n on Cloudflare Workers, two skills: astro-i18n adopts @edgekits/astro-i18n in an Astro site (translations in Workers KV, a per-namespace edge cache, typed keys, localized forms, multilingual SEO); tanstack-i18n adopts @edgekits/tanstack-i18n in a TanStack Start app sharing the same translations.
